（按讚訂閱打開小鈴鐺）
再來看一下今天的台股!
加權指數今日開低走低，終場下跌960.65點，收在48341.31，成交量11250.07億。
觀察三大法人今天籌碼動向，外資賣超1653.42億元，投信買超238.72億元，自營商賣超569.76億元，三大法人合計賣超1984.46億元，其中，外資連賣五日、自營商連賣四日，投信則連買三日共買超356.83億元 。

美國股市周一漲跌互見，道瓊工業指數上漲0.38%，科技股則相對承壓，那斯達克指數下跌0.44%，費城半導體指數重挫2.67%，受到沙烏地阿拉伯利雅德國際機場遭遇攻擊影響，市場避險情緒升溫，國際油價上漲，加上投資人等待美國大型銀行第三季財報及重要經濟數據，科技股賣壓明顯，不過AI產業發展仍有新進展，(META-US)Meta，上漲3.38%，推出旗下最新AI模型Muse Wonder，(MSFT-US)微軟，則發表第三代自研AI晶片Maia 300，規劃明年可能部署逾100萬顆，顯示大型科技廠持續擴大AI基礎建設投資，另一方面，(MU-US)美光，下跌3.88%，市場持續評估中國長鑫存儲帶來的競爭壓力，反映半導體族群短線仍有個別公司基本面與評價面的差異。

回到台股，受到美股科技股走弱及蘋果下修訂單等消息影響，加權指數今日開盤承壓，盤中一度重挫逾1,200點，市場情緒明顯受到衝擊，不過隨著指數跌幅逐步收斂，終場下跌960.65點，收在48341.31，成交量11250.07億，收盤留下影線274.95點，顯示低檔仍有買盤承接，月線附近的支撐力道值得持續觀察，台股今年以來累積漲幅仍相對突出，短線面臨國際利空與獲利了結賣壓，出現較大幅度修正並不意外，從另一個角度來看，適度整理也有助於籌碼沉澱，先前想要買股票的人，在此出現獲利了結的賣壓，所以才會呈現爆量的現象，緩漲急跌屬於多頭的修正，加上台積電9月營收年增54.6%，連續兩個月突破5,000億元，展現AI需求與先進製程帶來的營運動能，後續法說會若對Q4營運、先進製程需求及資本支出能夠釋出佳音，台股將有望迎接反彈格局，
台股有望先下後上，本周市場焦點相當密集，包括(2330-TW)台積電法說會、美國9月消費者物價指數CPI、生產者物價指數PPI及零售銷售數據，另外( GS-US)高盛，(C-US)花旗，與(JPM-US)摩根大通，等大型銀行也將陸續公布第三季財報，(ASML-US)艾司摩爾，的財報與展望同樣值得留意，這些資訊將牽動市場對通膨、利率走勢、

權值股方面，(2330-TW)台積電，下跌1.97%，收在2490元，法說會即將登場，市場聚焦營收展望、資本支出及2027年漲價策略，外資普遍看好AI運算、3奈米與2奈米需求，預期全年營收成長有望再上修，部分法人更看好明年營收續強，資本支出方面，外資預估未來幾年仍將維持高檔，反映先進製程擴產與AI長期需求，另一方面，先進製程報價也有望調漲5%至10%，帶動獲利成長，多家外資同步調升目標價，顯示市場對台積電長線競爭力仍具信心，後續法說展望將成為台股重要風向球；

(2317-TW)鴻海，下跌1.84%，收在240元，2026年OCP全球高峰會登場，鴻海展示輝達Vera Rubin NVL72平台及新一代AI機櫃方案，布局涵蓋高速互連、電力供應與液冷散熱，旗下鴻佰科技提供NVIDIA平台支援，鴻騰精密則聚焦資料中心高速傳輸與散熱需求，此外，鴻海攜手( INTC-US)英特爾，以Xeon平台推進機架級代理AI解決方案，隨著AI運算密度與機櫃功耗持續提升，鴻海從關鍵零組件、運算托盤到整機櫃系統的整合能力，有望掌握AI資料中心建置商機，挹注長期成長動能；

(2454-TW)聯發科，下跌2.16%，收在4525元，聯發科9月營收554億元，月減13.7%，但第三季營收達1,681億元，季增10.4%、年增18.3%，不僅優於原先預期，更高於財測上緣，主要受惠旗艦手機晶片出貨及AI網通需求強勁，展望第四季，隨著ASIC業務正式出貨，營收與獲利可望進一步攀升，2027年TPU出貨量若倍增，聯發科預期可望取得重要供貨比重，帶動ASIC營收占比提升，憑藉手機晶片與AI運算雙引擎，聯發科長期成長動能值得期待。
2026.7.6 股市期皇后領先預告(3265-TW)台星科

台星科9月營收3.998億元，年增11.5%，前9月累計39.38億元，年增15.9%，單看營收成長並不突出，但市場焦點已轉向2027年AI與HPC需求，公司預期AI ASIC將成主要成長動能，2奈米產品完成認證，大尺寸FCBGA及先進封裝同步擴產，並將2026年資本支出提高至134億元，隨雲端客戶自研ASIC需求升溫，晶圓測試、成品測試與先進封裝可望同步受惠，若後續訂單與產能利用率持續提升，營運成長有機會加速。
2026.9.23 股市期皇后領先預告(6742-TW)澤米
澤米，主要從事精密光學元件、半導體光學鍍膜及薄膜濾光片等業務，受惠AI智慧眼鏡與XR裝置發展，市場關注光學鍍膜需求成長，近期股價走強，成為AI智慧眼鏡概念股中受關注的個股，題材聚焦Google I/O及科技大廠新品布局，不過後續仍須觀察相關產品量產進度、訂單挹注及營收年增率，才能進一步確認題材是否轉化為實質營運成長，支撐股價後續表現。
2026.5.27 股市期皇后領先預告(1303-TW)南亞

南亞塑膠受惠AI伺服器及高速網通需求持續升溫，高階銅箔基板CCL出貨成長、產品組合升級與產能利用率提升，可望帶動獲利進入強勁復甦期，法人預估，2026年電子材料事業將貢獻約85%營業利益，隨M8以上高階產品放量，加上2027年起玻纖布與CCL產能擴充，毛利率仍有提升空間，此外，塑膠及化工本業逐步回溫，轉投資南亞科與台塑化的獲利貢獻改善，也有助挹注整體業績，預估2026至2028年稅後淨利將持續成長，搭配AI材料需求擴張與垂直整合優勢，南亞塑膠營運前景值得關注，後續可留意高階CCL放量進度、產能擴建效益及轉投資收益變化。

(4903-TW)聯光通，積極轉型工程及能源領域，9月營收創近13年新高，營運成長逐漸展現成果，公司在儲能工程方面已有鋼鐵業建置案在手，預計第四季完工，明年相關建置規模亦有望擴大，帶動工程業務持續貢獻營收，此外，AI資料中心與高速傳輸需求提升，也為光通訊產業帶來新的成長機會，聯光通同步布局特殊型光纖、MPO及FAU等產品，力拚切入高速傳輸供應鏈，整體而言，公司具備儲能工程與光通訊雙軌發展題材，後續可留意訂單轉換、營收成長及獲利改善情況，若基本面持續改善且市場資金回流相關族群，股價仍有進一步表現空間。
6505-TW)台塑化，亮燈漲停!再創波段新高!
台塑四寶昨日公告Q3獲利，(Q3稅後淨利262.89億元、EPS達2.76元，創單季新高紀錄，永豐投顧今日隨即調高目標價至125元，帶動台塑化今日盤中股價最高一度來到118.5元，不少散戶喊「大牛動了，要漲停嗎？」，截至10:42分為止，股價上漲7.5元、暫報116.5元，成交量近5萬張。
(6505-TW)台塑化，Q進入全球煉油廠密集檢修期，在中東與俄羅斯煉油廠難以恢復運轉下，大西洋柴油與亞洲柴油價差都維持高檔，預期第四季柴油價差明顯優於歷年同期；此外，戰事導致中東、俄羅斯汽油出口下降，亞洲汽油價差也將大幅高於過往冬季水準，有助於第四季毛利率維持強勁。

paras_en: Large-Volume Strong-Rising Stocks Review: Taiwan market falls below 49,000 points! Is it still too late to escape? Missing this Q4 sector will regret it! Must‑buy list revealed!
(Like, subscribe and turn on the little bell)
Now let's look at today's Taiwan market!
The weighted index opened lower and stayed lower today, closing down 960.65 points at 48,341.31 with a turnover of 1,125.007 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' chip movements today: foreign investors sold a net 165.342 billion NT$, investment trusts bought a net 23.872 billion NT$, and proprietary traders sold a net 56.976 billion NT$, for a combined net sell of 198.446 billion NT$. Among them, foreign investors have been selling for five consecutive days, proprietary traders for four days, while investment trusts have been buying for three days, net buying 35.683 billion NT$.

U.S. markets on Monday were mixed. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.38%, while tech stocks were under pressure; the Nasdaq fell 0.44% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 2.67% after the attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport heightened safe‑haven sentiment, pushing up oil prices. Investors are awaiting Q3 earnings from major U.S. banks and key economic data, leading to clear selling pressure on tech stocks. However, AI developments continued: Meta (META‑US) rose 3.38% after launching its latest AI model Muse Wonder; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) announced its third‑generation self‑developed AI chip Maia 300, planning to deploy over one million units next year, showing big tech’s ongoing AI infrastructure investment; meanwhile, Micron (MU‑US) fell 3.88% as the market assessed competitive pressure from China’s ChangXin Memory.

Back to Taiwan, the weighted index was pressured at the open by weak U.S. tech stocks and news of Apple cutting orders. It plunged more than 1,200 points intraday, clearly shaking market sentiment. As the decline narrowed, it closed down 960.65 points at 48,341.31 with a turnover of 1,125.007 billion, leaving a lower‑shadow of 274.95 points, indicating buying support at lower levels. The monthly‑line support near the index is worth watching. Taiwan’s year‑to‑date gains remain relatively strong. Short‑term, international downside news and profit‑taking pressure cause a sizable correction, which is not surprising. From another angle, moderate consolidation helps chip accumulation. Those who wanted to buy earlier now face profit‑taking sell pressure, creating high‑volume activity. A gradual rise after a sharp fall is a bullish correction. Moreover, TSMC’s September revenue grew 54.6% YoY, breaking the NT$500 billion mark for two consecutive months, demonstrating AI demand and advanced‑process momentum. If the upcoming earnings briefing releases good news on Q4 operations, advanced‑process demand, and capex, the market could see a rebound.

The Taiwan market may dip first then rise. This week’s focus is dense, including TSMC’s earnings briefing (2330‑TW), U.S. September CPI, PPI and retail sales data. In addition, major banks such as Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), Citigroup (C‑US) and JPMorgan (JPM‑US) will release Q3 earnings, and ASML’s (ASML‑US) results and outlook are also worth watching. These data will move market expectations on inflation and interest‑rate trends.

Among heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW) fell 1.97% to NT$2,490. Its earnings briefing is imminent, with the market focusing on revenue outlook, capex and the 2027 price‑increase strategy. Foreign investors are generally optimistic about AI computing, 3‑nm and 2‑nm demand, expecting full‑year revenue growth to be revised upward, and some even see stronger revenue next year. Capex is projected to stay high for several years, reflecting advanced‑process expansion and long‑term AI demand. Advanced‑process pricing may rise 5‑10%, boosting profits. Several foreign institutions have raised their target prices, showing confidence in TSMC’s long‑term competitiveness. The upcoming briefing will be a key market barometer.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) fell 1.84% to NT$240. At the 2026 OCP Global Summit, Foxconn showcased NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin NVL72 platform and a next‑generation AI rack solution, covering high‑speed interconnect, power supply and liquid‑cooling. Its subsidiary Hon Hai Precision (Hongbai Technology) provides NVIDIA platform support, while Foxconn Precision focuses on data‑center high‑speed transmission and cooling. Foxconn also partners with Intel (INTC‑US) to push Xeon‑based rack‑level AI solutions. As AI compute density and rack power consumption rise, Foxconn’s integration from key components to full‑rack systems positions it to capture data‑center construction opportunities, fueling long‑term growth.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) fell 2.16% to NT$4,525. September revenue was NT$55.4 billion, down 13.7% month‑over‑month, but Q3 revenue reached NT$168.1 billion, up 10.4% QoQ and 18.3% YoY, beating expectations and the upper end of forecasts, driven by flagship‑phone chip shipments and strong AI networking demand. Looking ahead to Q4, with ASIC business shipments starting, revenue and profit are expected to climb further. If TPU shipments double in 2027, MediaTek anticipates a larger share of supply, raising ASIC revenue proportion. With dual engines of mobile chips and AI computing, MediaTek’s long‑term growth momentum is promising.
July 6, 2026 – Stock Futures Queen preview for Taiwan Star (3265‑TW).
Taiwan Star (3265‑TW) moved from 184.5 to 273, a +47% jump after the preview.

Taiwan Star’s September revenue was NT$3.998 billion, up 11.5% YoY; cumulative Jan‑Sep revenue reached NT$39.38 billion, up 15.9% YoY. Revenue growth alone isn’t spectacular, but market focus has shifted to AI and HPC demand in 2027. The company expects AI ASICs to become the main growth driver, has completed 2‑nm product qualification, and is expanding large‑size FCBGA and advanced packaging. Capital expenditure for 2026 is raised to NT$13.4 billion. With cloud customers’ in‑house ASIC demand heating up, wafer testing, final‑product testing and advanced packaging should benefit. If orders and capacity utilization keep rising, operational growth could accelerate.
September 23, 2026 – Stock Futures Queen preview for Zemi (6742‑TW).
Zemi (6742‑TW) moved from 55.2 to 66.1, a +20% jump after the preview.

Zemi focuses on precision optical components, semiconductor optical coatings and thin‑film filters. Benefiting from AI smart‑glasses and XR device development, the market watches growing demand for optical coatings. The stock has recently strengthened, becoming a notable AI smart‑glasses concept stock, with attention on Google I/O and major tech‑company product launches. However, future performance depends on product mass‑production progress, order inflow and year‑over‑year revenue growth to confirm whether the theme translates into real operational growth.
May 27, 2026 – Stock Futures Queen preview for Nan Ya (1303‑TW).
Nan Ya (1303‑TW) moved from 79 to 319, a +303% jump after the preview.

Nan Ya Plastics benefits from rising AI server and high‑speed networking demand. Higher‑grade copper‑foil CCL shipments, product mix upgrades and higher capacity utilization should drive a strong profit recovery. Institutions estimate that the electronic‑materials segment will contribute about 85% of operating profit in 2026. With M8‑and‑above high‑end products scaling up and expanded glass‑fiber and CCL capacity from 2027, gross margins have room to improve. Additionally, the core plastics and chemicals business is warming, and earnings from investments in Nan Ya Chemical and Formosa Plastics help lift overall performance. Net profit after tax is projected to keep growing from 2026 to 2028, supported by expanding AI material demand and vertical integration. Watch the rollout of high‑end CCL, capacity expansion benefits and changes in investment earnings.

Lian Guang Tong (4903‑TW) is actively shifting to engineering and energy sectors. September revenue hit a 13‑year high, showing gradual operational growth. The company already has a steel‑industry energy‑storage project underway, expected to finish in Q4, with larger installations planned for next year, boosting engineering revenue. Moreover, rising AI data‑center and high‑speed transmission demand creates new growth opportunities for the optical‑communication industry. Lian Guang Tong is also developing specialty fibers, MPO and FAU products to enter the high‑speed transmission supply chain. Overall, the firm has dual‑track themes of energy‑storage engineering and optical communications; watch order conversion, revenue growth and profit improvement, as well as capital inflows into related sectors for further stock upside.
6505‑TW) Formosa Plastics Corp., lights up with a limit‑up! Sets a new wave high!
Mid‑Autumn investment tip (6505‑TW) Formosa Plastics: 87.3 → 119 → a massive +36% rise.

Formosa Plastics’ four‑major subsidiaries announced Q3 profit: after‑tax net profit NT$26.289 billion, EPS NT$2.76, a quarterly record. Yuanta Investment raised its target price to NT$125, pushing the intraday price up to NT$118.5. Retail investors shouted “The big bull is moving, should it hit limit‑up?” As of 10:42 am, the stock was up NT$7.5 at NT$116.5 with a volume near 50,000 lots.

Formosa Plastics (6505‑TW) is entering the global refinery intensive maintenance period. With Middle‑East and Russian refineries struggling to resume operations, the Atlantic‑diesel‑to‑Asian‑diesel spread stays high, and the Q4 diesel spread is expected to be markedly better than historical averages. Additionally, war‑driven reductions in Middle‑East and Russian gasoline exports mean Asian gasoline spreads will be far above typical winter levels, supporting strong Q4 margins.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：高檔放量重挫，短線賣壓加劇

台股今日呈現「開低震盪拉回」格局，盤中一度下跌1,235點、下探48,066點，終場下跌960點，收在48,341點，成交值放大至約1兆1,311億元。
指數跌破10日線，但仍守在月線之上，顯示短線多方動能受到壓抑，市場進入高檔籌碼重新整理階段，後續須觀察月線能否提供有效支撐。
國際油價攀升、通膨疑慮升溫、利率上行壓力，以及AI投資報酬與獲利變現疑慮，成為市場主要利空；加上高檔獲利了結與融資賣壓同步釋放，導致盤面震盪加劇。
籌碼方面，外資賣超1,653億元、自營商賣超569億元，投信則買超238億元。法人動向明顯分歧，短線應留意外資賣壓是否延續，以及市場成交量能否逐步收斂。


二、基本面分析：AI成長趨勢仍是多頭核心支柱

儘管短線面臨國際利率與估值修正壓力，但AI晶片新品放量、雲端服務業者持續擴大資本支出，以及先進製程與封裝需求成長，仍是支撐台股企業獲利的重要動能。
展望第四季，輝達Vera Rubin平台相關供應鏈、AI伺服器、先進封裝及高速傳輸等領域，可望受惠新平台導入與規格升級；蘋果新機出貨、歐美年末消費旺季，也有助部分電子供應鏈營收成長。
除電子產業外，金融股可留意利率環境對利差與獲利的影響；重電產業受惠海外電力建設需求，航運業則須觀察地緣政治與運價變化，塑化業則應同步評估原油成本與產品報價，掌握不同產業的輪動機會。
中長期而言，AI需求正由晶片延伸至資料中心、電力、散熱及高速互連，產業成長範圍擴大，有助支撐台股基本面。不過，企業資本支出能否轉化為實際營收與獲利，仍是後續評價能否維持的關鍵。


三、產業焦點：掌握AI基礎建設與規格升級商機

晶圓代工、先進製程與封裝設備： AI晶片持續追求高效能、低功耗，先進製程與CoWoS先進封裝需求仍值得關注。台積電(2330-TW)近期營運展望與法說內容，將是觀察AI需求能否持續轉化為實際營收的重要指標。
ASIC、高速傳輸與PCB材料： Google TPU、AWS Trainium及其他CSP自研晶片發展，有利IC設計服務、PCB、CCL、高階玻纖布及ABF載板需求。野村投信亦看好滑軌、散熱與CCL等供應鏈，但個別公司仍須檢視訂單、產能與毛利率變化。
散熱、電源與光通訊： AI伺服器功耗提高，帶動液冷、水冷板、電源管理與高速光連接需求，應優先關注具有量產實績、客戶認證及技術門檻的企業。
金融與傳產輪動： 金融股、重電、航運及塑化可作為分散布局方向，但須分別評估利率、海外訂單、地緣政治、運價及原料成本，避免僅憑題材追價。


四、技術面與籌碼：先觀察止跌訊號，不急著猜底

指數失守10日線且成交量放大，代表短線修正壓力升高；月線能否守穩、季線是否持續上揚，將是判斷中期多頭架構的重要依據。
外資單日大幅賣超，且新台幣走貶，顯示資金面仍有壓力。國際市場近期亦出現AI晶片股回檔，反映投資人開始更重視資本支出的獲利回收與投資報酬。
操作上應觀察下跌量能是否收斂、外資賣壓是否減輕，以及指數能否重新站回短期均線；若月線失守且反彈無量，應提高風險控管，不宜預設指數必然快速重返5萬點。


五、操作策略：選股不選市，分批布局優於追高

核心布局： 優先挑選訂單能見度高、獲利可持續成長、財務體質穩健的AI龍頭與關鍵零組件廠，譬如CPO概念股股大立光(3008-TW)、玉晶光(3406-TW)、中揚光(6668-TW)、冠西電(2466-TW)、網安其陽(3564-TW)、被動天二科(6834-TW)、LED雷笛克(5230-TW)、機構件閎暉(3311-TW)…等，其個股表現則是相當地亮眼。
進場原則： 等待股價回測支撐、賣壓減輕，再採分批布局；對高估值、短線急漲及獲利尚未兌現的個股，應保留安全邊際，譬如MCU應廣(6716-TW)、設備大量(3167-TW)、蔚華科(3055-TW)、PA全新(2455-TW)、光通訊聯亞(3081-TW)、上詮(3363-TW)、矽晶圓環球晶(6488-TW)、台勝科(3532-TW)、鋼鐵大甲(2221-TW)、彰源(2030-TW)、強新(5013-TW)…等，今日持續應聲下殺跌停，仍應速速避開之為宜。
風險管理： 避免融資追價，設定個股停損與持股比重，並持續追蹤美債殖利率、油價、匯率、法人籌碼及企業財報。


整體結論： 台股中長期仍有AI產業成長支撐，但短線已由單純追逐題材，轉向檢驗獲利與評價的階段。第四季可持續看好具實質訂單與獲利成長的優質企業，但應以基本面、技術面及風險控管並重，耐心等待合理買點，而非預設指數必然上漲。

items.title: 多頭滿四年藏隱憂！標普500逾八成個股從高點跌逾10% 專家揭：全靠少數科技巨頭苦撐
items.title_en: Bull Market Lasts Four Years but Hidden Risks Loom! Over 80% of S&P 500 Stocks Down More Than 10% From Peaks, Experts Say: Only a Few Tech Giants Are Holding It Up
paras: 根據市場分析機構Kobeissi Letter最新分析，目前標普500指數約84%的成分股，股價較各自歷史高點至少下跌10%，顯示若沒有一些大型股的亮眼漲勢支撐，標普500指數的表現恐怕將相當難看，也難以持續徘徊在歷史高點附近。
Yahoo Finance報導，目前標普500指數的11個類股中，房地產類股回檔最嚴重，97%的成分股較歷史高點下跌至少10%，符合技術面「修正」的定義。次差為原物料類股，占96%，接著為公用事業類股，占94%，以及非必需消費品類股，占92%。
這些產業的疲弱，可能反映市場對企業獲利的疑慮，尤其是房市與零售業等易受高利率影響的產業。
相較之下，能源類股表現相對抗跌，僅62%的成分股較歷史高點下跌逾10%，接著是醫療保健類股，占70%，科技類股則占72%。
如果把門檻改成從高點回跌至少20%，也就是華爾街傳統上所稱的「熊市」，標普500指數有59%的成分股已符合這個標準。跌幅超過30%占了41%，跌了超過50%的另有17%。
Kobeissi Letter策略師說：「少數幾檔股票正支撐著整個股市。」
儘管標普500指數表面之下的跌勢持續擴大，市場仍完成一項重要里程碑。根據Truist共同投資長Keith Lerner提供的數據，投資人目前正處於1950年代以來的第11次多頭市場。
這波多頭行情在周二(10月12日)滿四年，成為歷來第七次持續至少完整四年的多頭市場。標普500指數周二幾乎收在平盤，小跌4.30點或不到0.1%，收在7807.24點。
若與1950年代以來的歷次多頭市場相比，本輪行情累計上漲119%，漲幅大致位於中間水準，遠低於2009年至2020年多頭市場的401%，也不及1987年至2000年多頭市場的582%。
Lerner統計期間內，多頭市場的平均漲幅為184%。而過去10次多頭市場中，有六次持續時間超過四年。
paras_en: According to the latest analysis from market‑research firm Kobeissi Letter, about 84% of the S&P 500’s constituents are trading at least 10% below their respective historical highs, indicating that without the strong gains of a handful of large‑cap stocks, the index’s performance could look bleak and it will struggle to stay near its record levels.

Yahoo Finance reports that among the S&P 500’s 11 sectors, real‑estate stocks have the steepest pull‑back, with 97% of the sector’s components down at least 10% from their peaks, meeting the technical definition of a correction. The next worst sector is materials at 96%, followed by utilities at 94% and consumer discretionary at 92%.
The weakness in these industries may reflect market doubts about corporate earnings, especially in sectors such as housing and retail that are highly sensitive to higher interest rates.
By contrast, energy stocks have been relatively resilient, with only 62% of the sector’s constituents down more than 10% from their highs, followed by health‑care at 70% and technology at 72%.

If the threshold is widened to a drop of at least 20% from peak – the level traditionally called a “bear market” on Wall Street – 59% of S&P 500 components meet that criterion. Stocks down over 30% account for 41%, and those down more than 50% make up another 17%.
A Kobeissi Letter strategist said, “A handful of stocks are propping up the entire market.”

Even though the underlying decline beneath the S&P 500’s surface is widening, the market has still achieved a key milestone. Data from Truist co‑CIO Keith Lerner shows investors are currently in the 11th bull market since the 1950s.

The current bull run hit the four‑year mark on Tuesday, October 12, becoming the seventh instance in history of a bull market lasting at least a full four years. The S&P 500 closed Tuesday almost flat, down 4.30 points or less than 0.1% at 7,807.24.

Compared with every bull market since the 1950s, this rally has risen a cumulative 119%, a mid‑range gain that is far below the 401% rise in the 2009‑2020 bull market and the 582% gain in the 1987‑2000 bull market.
Lerner notes that the average gain across bull markets in the sample period is 184%, and that six of the past ten bull markets have lasted more than four years.

天意能創總經理李靜綺指出，AI 算力蓬勃發展帶動產業對水電資源效率的需求提升，天意能創將水與能源轉化為長期優質的營運資產，從源頭診斷到末端 AI 代操作一次打通，協助企業透過單一窗口提升營運韌性，讓每一滴水、每一度電，都發揮最大效益。

因應全球永續轉型浪潮與環保法規升級，企業面臨的廢水與能源問題往往同時涵蓋水質、設備選型、機電控制、工程施工及能耗管理，單一設備廠商無法解決整體問題。天意能創指出，公司承接力麗集團累積經驗，將水處理、再生水、再生能源與後端維運納入同一張藍圖，提供完整的一站式服務，消弭傳統多方對接的工程溝通成本。面對既有廠房設備老化與法規升級需求，天意能創能透過廠區健檢與前瞻設備布局，協助企業按預算與預期效益排出改善優先順序，讓投資精準落在有效環節並持續追蹤營運效益。
天意能創整合四個專業團隊，形成從研究、設計到維運的完整服務鏈。在創能綠電方面，日向電能提供太陽能結合儲能的光儲合一系統，協助企業自發自用、削峰填谷並具備停電備援。在精準設計方面，山林旭科技主導工程建置，導入BIM 3D精準建模，大幅降低管線衝突及有效落實設計，且擁有8件水回收相關專利，於設計階段即選用高效率鼓風機與變頻泵浦提升能效，並即時監控水質調整加藥。

天意能創指出，公司在核心淨水方面，環鼎國際擁有 25 年水處理經驗，代理關鍵核心技術之設備，日本三菱 MBR膜與瑞典 Nordic Water 盤式過濾器，並發展自主 ECO 系列技術、持有台灣發明與新型專利，設有自有實驗室並與大學建教合作，堅持先研究再規劃流程，專攻高難度水質處理，降低選錯設備風險。在AI智慧維運方面，天意能創與同屬力麗集團的合作夥伴鴻傑工程，建置 AI 雲端戰情室，依智慧儀表即時水質動態精準調控曝氣，最佳化水廠用電與營運效率。

天意能創並指出，公司團隊成員深耕水處理、水再生工程，山林旭積極參與國家級科學園區污水處理廠之建設，涵蓋竹科寶山二期擴建與中科二林園區等污水處理廠工程，累積多項實績。環鼎除了提供高雄楠梓污水處理廠處理量每日6萬噸盤式過濾系統，也參與高雄楠梓再生水廠興建，產水規模為每日7萬噸，包含MBR、MBBR、SUF等關鍵設備及系統設計，山林旭落實工程建置，完成可靠的工程交付。在 MBR 系統上，環鼎代理的三菱MBR膜在各科學園區污水處理廠應用廣泛。
依統計科學園區污水處理廠採用MBR系統處理的總水量合計約為每日25.9萬噸，其中17.9萬噸即採用三菱膜系統，占比約為70%。由團隊累積工程與操作維護的自主技術，已將臺灣經驗帶回日本，進行雙向技術交流與後續合作規劃。在AI智慧維運方面攜手合作夥伴鴻傑工程，建置 AI 雲端戰情室，將即時水質動態精準進行曝氣，水量等系統調配分析建議，提供水廠用電與營運效率最適化調整。
在水資源回收、節能與能源回收方面，天意能創已有具體成果：林口電廠 Eco-RO 水回收率逾 60%，臺中福田水資中心盤式過濾系統日處理量達10.5萬噸，台糖東海豐園區相較傳統豬舍節水約 80% 至 83% 且年減碳2000公噸。在廢水能源回收上，酒廠與合纖廠導入 Eco-ECSB 高效率顆粒污泥厭氧技術，其中合纖廠曝氣能耗減少 85%，並回收沼氣作為熱能與電力。
paras_en: Lih Li (1444-TW) Group’s subsidiary Tianyi Energy Creation (4530-TW) positions itself as a green infrastructure integrator, bringing together Shanlinxu, Huanding International, Nichiha Power and fellow group partner Hongjie Engineering as four major teams. By leveraging water resources, green power and AI‑enabled environmental engineering, it builds the “brain” for high‑tech factories and city infrastructure green transformation. The company notes that Tianyi Energy Creation was selected for the 2026 Taiwan International Water Week AquaImpact Sustainable Water Mark.

General Manager Li Jing‑qi explained that the rapid growth of AI computing is driving higher demand for water‑electricity efficiency across industries. Tianyi Energy Creation converts water and energy into long‑term high‑quality operating assets, linking source‑side diagnostics to end‑point AI‑driven operations in a single workflow. This helps enterprises boost operational resilience through a one‑stop portal, ensuring every drop of water and every kilowatt‑hour delivers maximum benefit.

In response to the global sustainability transition and tightening environmental regulations, companies face wastewater and energy challenges that span water quality, equipment selection, electromechanical control, construction and energy‑use management—issues a single equipment vendor cannot solve. Tianyi Energy Creation says it leverages Lih Li Group’s accumulated experience to integrate water treatment, reclaimed water, renewable energy and downstream O&M into one blueprint, offering a complete one‑stop service that eliminates the communication costs of traditional multi‑vendor projects. Confronting aging plant equipment and regulatory upgrades, the firm can conduct plant health checks and forward‑looking equipment planning to help firms prioritize improvements within budget and expected ROI, directing investment to the most effective points and continuously tracking operational benefits.

Tianyi Energy Creation unites four professional teams to create a full service chain from research and design to operation and maintenance. For green power generation, Nichiha Power supplies a solar‑plus‑storage “photovoltaic‑storage‑in‑one” system that enables self‑consumption, peak shaving, load shifting and backup during outages. In precision design, Shanlinxu Technology leads engineering construction, employing BIM 3D modeling to dramatically reduce pipe conflicts and ensure design fidelity. It holds eight water‑recycling‑related patents and selects high‑efficiency blowers and variable‑frequency pumps during the design phase to boost energy efficiency, while providing real‑time water‑quality monitoring and dosing control.

Tianyi Energy Creation notes that in core water‑purification, Huanding International brings 25 years of water‑treatment expertise, representing key technologies such as Japan’s Mitsubishi MBR membranes and Sweden’s Nordic Water disc filters. It has also developed its own ECO series, holds Taiwanese invention and utility patents, operates an in‑house laboratory and collaborates with universities, adhering to a research‑first approach for high‑difficulty water‑quality treatment and reducing the risk of selecting wrong equipment. For AI‑driven O&M, Tianyi Energy Creation partners with fellow Lih Li Group member Hongjie Engineering to build an AI cloud “war‑room,” using smart meters to dynamically and precisely control aeration based on real‑time water‑quality data, optimizing plant electricity use and operational efficiency.

The company’s team members have deep experience in water treatment and water‑recycling projects. Shanlinxu actively participates in national science‑park wastewater‑treatment plant construction, including the Phase‑2 expansion of Zhuke Baoshan and the Zhongke Erlin park, accumulating numerous achievements. Huanding supplies a 60,000‑ton‑per‑day disc‑filter system for Kaohsiung Nanzhi wastewater‑treatment plant and also contributes to the Kaohsiung Nanzhi reclaimed‑water plant producing 70,000 tons per day, featuring MBR, MBBR, SUF and other key equipment and system designs. Shanlinxu executes the engineering build, delivering reliable project hand‑over. Huanding’s Mitsubishi MBR membranes are widely used in science‑park wastewater plants.

Statistics show that science‑park wastewater plants using MBR systems treat about 259,000 tons of water daily, of which 179,000 tons (≈70 %) employ Mitsubishi membranes. The team’s accumulated engineering and maintenance expertise has been transferred back to Japan, enabling two‑way technology exchange and future collaboration planning. In AI‑enabled O&M, together with Hongjie Engineering, they have established an AI cloud war‑room that performs real‑time, precise aeration based on water‑quality dynamics and provides system‑level water‑flow and equipment allocation recommendations to optimize plant electricity consumption and operational efficiency.

In water‑resource recovery, energy saving and energy‑recovery, Tianyi Energy Creation already reports concrete results: at Linkou Power Plant the Eco‑RO system achieves over 60 % water‑recovery; Taichung Futian Water Resource Center’s disc‑filter system handles 105,000 tons per day; Taiwan Sugar’s Donghai Feng Park reduces water use by about 80‑83 % compared with conventional pig farms and cuts carbon emissions by 2,000 tons annually. For wastewater‑to‑energy, a distillery and a fiber‑manufacturing plant have adopted Eco‑ECSB high‑efficiency granular sludge anaerobic technology, with the fiber plant’s aeration energy dropping 85 % and biogas being recovered for heat and power.

items.title: 和椿Q3營收寫歷年單季新高 半導體、AI伺服器拉貨動能強勁
items.title_en: He Chun Reports Record Q3 Revenue, Driven by Strong Semiconductor and AI Server Demand
paras: AI與機器人自動化解決廠和椿(6215-TW)今(2026)年第3季合併營收達11.13億元、年增57.93%，改寫歷年單季新高，主要受惠於半導體、高階 AI 伺服器、電子製造等產業客戶對自動化設備與次系統(Subsystem)拉貨動能延續，和椿今年營收逐季走高，累計前3季合併營收 27.88億元，年增 55.39%。
和椿9月單月營收3.28億元，年增28.87%、月減19.59%，月減主因為部分自動化設備與次系統訂單，配合客戶現場建置時程及驗收規畫調整而遞延出貨，屬自動化設備產業常見的短期出貨節奏變化，並不影響整體訂單規模，遞延訂單將陸續於後續季度完成交貨與認列營收，整體出貨動能無虞。

近年全球機器人產業熱度升溫，從工業到自主移動機器人(AMR)紛紛加速落地，市場焦點已逐漸從「機器人本體」轉向「AI 控制與系統整合」，和椿指出，「機器人如果只有強大的機體與關節，充其量只是空有身體，真正的關鍵在於軟體控制、AI 視覺辨識以及感測決策系統，也就是機器人的大腦，隨著 AI 技術逐步進入實體應用，終端客戶不再滿足於採購單一品牌的機械手臂或移動載具，而是需要能配合複雜製程、彈性調度且高精度的「客製化AI智慧機器人整合解決方案」，讓軟硬體高度協同運作。
和椿近年來已成功轉型為高附加價值的「AI 智慧機器人整合解決方案商」，代理精密零組件起步，累積自研控制模組與自動化設備的研發製造實力，長期深耕半導體、電子製造等高科技產業，熟悉客戶的製程與現場作業條件。延伸至機器人領域後，更能從客戶的場域痛點出發，讓機器人與自動化設備在現場高效落地，協助半導體、AI伺服器、電子製造及物流等各產業客戶大幅降低導入自動化的門檻。
和椿近年來已成功轉型為高附加價值的「AI 智慧機器人整合解決方案商」，代理精密零組件起步，逐步累積自研控制模組與自動化設備的研發製造實力，長期深耕半導體、電子製造等高科技產業，熟悉客戶的製程與現場作業條件，讓機器人與自動化設備在現場高效落地，協助半導體、AI伺服器、電子製造及物流等各產業客戶大幅降低導入自動化的門檻。
展望未來，和椿將持續鎖定「半導體高階次系統」與「AI智慧機器人」兩大成長引擎，在第一曲線的自動化設備與次系統上深化技術護城河，更在第二曲線積極布局跨系統、多型態機器人的「無人工廠」與垂直場景落地方案，全力推升公司整體營運長期良好的成長動能。
paras_en: AI and robotics automation solutions provider He Chun (6215-TW) posted combined Q3 2026 revenue of NT$1.113 billion, up 57.93% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑quarter record. The surge was fueled by continued demand from semiconductor, high‑end AI server and electronics manufacturing customers for automation equipment and subsystems. He Chun’s revenue has risen each quarter this year, reaching NT$2.788 billion for the first three quarters, a 55.39% annual increase.

In September, He Chun recorded NT$328 million in revenue, up 28.87% year‑over‑year but down 19.59% month‑over‑month. The monthly decline reflects the postponement of some automation equipment and subsystem orders to align with customers’ on‑site installation schedules and acceptance plans – a typical short‑term fluctuation in the automation industry that does not affect the overall order volume. Deferred orders will be delivered and recognized as revenue in subsequent quarters, so overall shipment momentum remains intact.

The global robotics industry has heated up in recent years, with both industrial robots and autonomous mobile robots (AMR) accelerating deployment. Market focus is shifting from the robot hardware itself to AI control and system integration. He Chun notes that a robot with only a strong chassis and joints is merely a body; the real key lies in software control, AI visual recognition, and sensor‑based decision‑making – essentially the robot’s brain. As AI technologies move into physical applications, end‑users no longer settle for a single‑brand robotic arm or mobile platform; they demand customized AI‑smart robot integration solutions that can handle complex processes, flexible scheduling, and high precision, enabling tight hardware‑software synergy.

In recent years He Chun has successfully transformed into a high‑value‑added “AI smart robot integration solutions” provider. Starting with the distribution of precision components, the company has built in‑house capabilities in control modules and automation equipment R&D and manufacturing, deeply serving high‑tech sectors such as semiconductors and electronics manufacturing and gaining intimate knowledge of customers’ processes and on‑site conditions. Expanding into robotics, He Chun now addresses customers’ pain points by deploying robots and automation equipment efficiently on the shop floor, helping semiconductor, AI server, electronics manufacturing and logistics customers dramatically lower the barriers to automation adoption.

He Chun has evolved into a high‑value‑added “AI smart robot integration solutions” vendor, beginning with precision component distribution and gradually accumulating self‑developed control modules and automation equipment manufacturing expertise. By long‑term engagement with semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries, it understands customers’ processes and on‑site operational requirements, enabling robots and automation gear to be deployed efficiently on the floor and assisting clients in sectors such as semiconductors, AI servers, electronics manufacturing and logistics to significantly reduce automation entry hurdles.

Looking ahead, He Chun will continue to focus on two growth engines – advanced semiconductor subsystems and AI‑smart robots. It will deepen its technological moat on the first‑line automation equipment and subsystems while actively developing cross‑system, multi‑type robot “lights‑out factory” and vertical‑scenario solutions on the second line, driving sustained long‑term growth for the company.

items.title: 大魯閣在日本開匹克球俱樂部 明年起逐步發展連鎖經營
items.title_en: Taroko to Open Pickleball Club in Japan, Plans Chain Expansion Starting Next Year
paras: 大魯閣(1432-TW)今(13)日宣布，除了在日本開出棒壘球打擊場，預計12月下旬將在日本開「大魯閣匹克球俱樂部」，並與日本匹克球聯盟合作，明年起逐步發展成連鎖經營。
大魯閣瞄準匹克球市場，與JR東日本集團旗下「JR東日本都市開發株式會社」戰略合作，以運動休閒項目為主題、並活化鐵路沿線空間，預計12月下旬在千葉縣JR下總中山站附近，開首家大魯閣匹克球俱樂部(TAROKO Pickleball Club)。
大魯閣說明，匹克球俱樂部是利用鐵路高架橋下空間打造的全天候匹克球場，初期設置2面球場，預計明年起陸續擴充。
大魯閣近年積極拓展海外版圖，在美國已開5家據點，包括德州Katy、San Antonio，以及亞利桑那州Mesa、Chandler、Gilbert，透過大型室內運動娛樂中心與既有戶外場館改造，持續驗證不同店型的營運模式。
大魯閣在日本的首二座棒壘球打擊場也在近期開出，分別為千葉、宇都宮雙店，隨著美國5店、日本2店陸續加入營運，海外布局第一階段目標達陣。
展望下一階段，大魯閣表示，以「輕資產拓點、多元運動娛樂、棒球科技應用」為發展方向，持續深化在美國和日本市場的經營，拚做出源自台灣、走向國際的棒球運動娛樂品牌。
paras_en: Taroko (1432-TW) announced today, October 13, that in addition to opening a baseball‑softball batting cage in Japan, it plans to launch a "Taroko Pickleball Club" in late December and, in partnership with the Japan Pickleball League, will gradually develop a chain operation starting next year.

Targeting the growing pickleball market, Taroko is forming a strategic partnership with JR East’s subsidiary JR East Urban Development Co., focusing on sports‑leisure projects that revitalize spaces along railway lines. The first Taroko Pickleball Club (TAROKO Pickleball Club) is slated to open near JR Nakayama Station in Chiba Prefecture in late December.
Taroko explained that the pickleball club will be an all‑weather facility built under a railway viaduct, initially featuring two courts, with plans to expand further beginning next year.

In recent years Taroko has been actively expanding overseas. In the United States it already operates five locations—in Katy, Texas; San Antonio, Texas; and Mesa, Chandler and Gilbert in Arizona—using large indoor sports‑entertainment centers and converting existing outdoor venues, continuously testing different store formats.

Taroko’s first two baseball‑softball batting cages in Japan have also opened recently, located in Chiba and Utsunomiya. With the five U.S. sites and the two Japanese sites now operating, the first phase of its overseas rollout has been achieved.

Looking ahead to the next phase, Taroko says it will pursue a "light‑asset, multi‑sport entertainment, baseball‑technology" development strategy, deepening its presence in the U.S. and Japanese markets to build a baseball‑sports entertainment brand that originates in Taiwan and goes global.

items.title: 大魯閣插旗日本關東開出二大據點 將發展日本連鎖版圖
items.title_en: DaLuGe Flags Japan's Kanto Region with Two Major Sites, Aiming to Build a Japanese Chain Network
paras: 大魯閣實業(1432-TW)今(13)日宣布，海外市場布局創新里程碑，成功插旗日本，首波二家店開在關東地區，千葉店和宇都宮店將於10月10日正式開幕，並將作為未來加速在日本拓點的營運模組。
大魯閣表示，在日本的二大新據點是透過收購既有棒壘球打擊場來改造升級，以較低的資本投入及較短的籌備時間進入日本市場，並導入台灣成熟的運動娛樂經營模式及棒球科技。
大魯閣看好日本擁有深厚的棒球文化和廣大的棒球人口，打擊場具有穩定的市場基礎，但現有場館多以傳統投球機及單一打擊服務為主，部分場館面臨服務單一及營運模式缺乏創新等挑戰。
反觀台式打擊場結合多元球速與科技互動，並增加飛鏢機、娃娃機等遊戲娛樂及親子休閒服務，可讓棒球打擊從單純的練習活動，延伸為適合家庭、朋友及年輕族群參與的運動娛樂體驗。
大魯閣樂觀看日本既有打擊場的轉型商機，後續仍將尋找合適場館，透過收購、設備升級和營運內容優化，以較低資本支出加速拓點，逐步建立可複製的日本營運模式。
除了傳統打擊娛樂，大魯閣也將日本據點作為棒球運動科技的實際應用場域，第一階段導入美國HitTrax打擊系統，透過即時數據分析與互動競賽功能，提升打擊體驗與訓練效率，後續更規劃導入台灣自主研發的AI棒球打擊教練，提供個人化打擊分析與訓練建議。
paras_en: DaLuGe Industrial (1432-TW) announced today (the 13th) that it has reached a new milestone in its overseas market expansion by successfully planting its flag in Japan. The first two stores, located in the Kanto region, are the Chiba store and the Utsunomiya store, which will officially open on October 10 and will serve as the operational model for accelerating further expansion in Japan.

DaLuGe explained that the two new sites in Japan were created by acquiring existing baseball/softball batting facilities and upgrading them, allowing market entry with lower capital investment and a shorter preparation period. The company will introduce Taiwan’s mature sports‑entertainment management model and baseball technology into these venues.

DaLuGe is optimistic about Japan’s deep baseball culture and large baseball‑playing population, noting that batting facilities have a stable market base. However, many existing venues rely on traditional pitching machines and offer only single‑service batting, facing challenges such as limited service offerings and a lack of innovative operating models.

In contrast, Taiwanese‑style batting centers combine varied pitch speeds with interactive technology and add games such as darts and claw machines, as well as family‑friendly leisure services. This transforms baseball batting from a purely practice activity into a sports‑entertainment experience suitable for families, friends and younger audiences.

DaLuGe is positive about the transformation opportunities for existing Japanese batting facilities. It will continue to seek suitable venues and, through acquisitions, equipment upgrades and content optimization, accelerate expansion with relatively low capital outlay, gradually establishing a replicable operating model in Japan.

Beyond traditional batting entertainment, DaLuGe will use its Japanese sites as real‑world applications for baseball technology. In the first phase it will install the U.S. HitTrax batting system, leveraging real‑time data analysis and interactive competition features to enhance the batting experience and training efficiency. Future plans include introducing Taiwan‑developed AI baseball batting coaches to provide personalized analysis and training recommendations.

items.title: 正文攜手高通、gFiber 將邊緣AI技術導入Wi-Fi 8寬頻閘道器
items.title_en: Wistron Teams with Qualcomm and gFiber to Bring Edge AI to Wi‑Fi 8 Broadband Gateways
paras: 網通廠正文(4906-TW)今(13)日於 Network X2026 展會發表全新 AI 原生 Wi-Fi 8 寬頻閘道器。該產品是與高通(QCOM-US)及營運商 gFiber, Inc.（原 Google Fiber）合作開發，將邊緣 AI及下一代連線技術帶入家庭網路生活。
正文指出，該閘道器採用高通 Dragonwing™ NPro A8 Elite 平台，由正文科技進行產品工程設計，搭載正文科技子公司 Genix Networks 的智慧軟體，並由營運商 gFiber 推出服務。該設備結合了 Wi-Fi 8 四頻連線技術、邊緣 AI（Edge AI）運算以及智慧軟體，提供更即時流暢的寬頻體驗。
使用者可透過自然語言語音指令管理家庭網路，或存取支援的各項服務。相關請求指令，能在本地端即時處理，不僅有助於保護個人隱私，更能提升回應速度，並降低對雲端資源的依賴。
Genix 軟體能透過 AI 驅動的介面，將閘道器、設備與網路完美連結，並整合了支援語音控制的應用程式，讓使用者能隨時詢問設備動態、效能與安全性，並執行相應支援的操作。
正文科技將客戶終端設備（CPE）重新塑造為客廳中令人矚目的亮點。這款網路閘道器結合了獨具巧思的外觀設計，以及直覺化的互動方式，將家庭連線與日常服務融入一台讓人樂於展示與使用的設備中。
正文表示，本次合作中，高通提供先進的連線與 AI 平台技術，正文主導產品與 AI 系統創新，將硬體與 Genix 軟體整合為電信級網路閘道器，gFiber：打造終端用戶體驗，並預計成為首家部署該產品的營運商。三方正共同探索一套全新的寬頻模式，從平台層級到用戶體驗，整合了技術、產品與 AI 系統創新，並計畫於 2027 年進行商業部署。
正文科技執行長李榮昌表示：「要將智慧科技導入寬頻領域，既是技術上的挑戰，更是系統整合的考驗。本次合作結合了高通的 Wi-Fi 8 平台、gFiber 的用戶經驗，以及正文科技的產品工程和 Genix 軟體實力，我們將攜手打造出一款營運商能夠順利部署、用戶能在日常生活中輕鬆使用的產品。」
paras_en: Wistron Corp. (4906‑TW) unveiled a brand‑new AI‑native Wi‑Fi 8 broadband gateway today (13th) at the Network X2026 exhibition. The product was co‑developed with Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) and carrier gFiber, Inc. (formerly Google Fiber), bringing edge AI and next‑generation connectivity into the home network experience.

Wistron noted that the gateway uses Qualcomm’s Dragonwing™ NPro A8 Elite platform, with product engineering handled by Wistron and smart software from its subsidiary Genix Networks, while gFiber will offer the service. The device combines Wi‑Fi 8 four‑band connectivity, edge AI processing and intelligent software to deliver a more immediate and smooth broadband experience.

Users can manage their home network via natural‑language voice commands or access supported services. Such requests are processed locally in real time, which helps protect personal privacy, speeds up response times and reduces reliance on cloud resources.

Genix software provides an AI‑driven interface that seamlessly links the gateway, devices and network, and integrates voice‑controlled applications so users can inquire about device status, performance and security at any time and trigger appropriate actions.

Wistron is reshaping the customer premises equipment (CPE) into a striking centerpiece for the living room. The network gateway features a thoughtfully designed exterior and intuitive interaction, merging home connectivity and everyday services into a device that users enjoy displaying and using.

Wistron said that in this collaboration Qualcomm supplies advanced connectivity and AI platform technology, Wistron leads product and AI system innovation, integrating hardware with Genix software into a carrier‑grade network gateway, while gFiber focuses on the end‑user experience and is slated to be the first carrier to deploy the product. The three parties are jointly exploring a new broadband model that spans platform to user experience, integrating technology, product and AI system innovations, with commercial rollout planned for 2027.

Wistron CEO Li Rong‑chang said, “Bringing smart technology into the broadband space is not only a technical challenge but also a test of system integration. This partnership combines Qualcomm’s Wi‑Fi 8 platform, gFiber’s user experience, and Wistron’s product engineering and Genix software capabilities. Together we will create a product that carriers can deploy smoothly and that users can easily adopt in their daily lives.”

Now let's look at today's Taiwan market!
The weighted index opened lower and stayed lower today, closing down 960.65 points at 48,341.31 with a turnover of 1,125.007 billion.

Observing the three major institutional investors' chip movements today: foreign investors sold a net 165.342 billion NT$, investment trusts bought a net 23.872 billion NT$, and proprietary traders sold a net 56.976 billion NT$, for a combined net sell of 198.446 billion NT$. Among them, foreign investors have been selling for five consecutive days, proprietary traders for four days, while investment trusts have been buying for three days, net buying 35.683 billion NT$.

U.S. markets on Monday were mixed. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.38%, while tech stocks were under pressure; the Nasdaq fell 0.44% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 2.67% after the attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport heightened safe‑haven sentiment, pushing up oil prices. Investors are awaiting Q3 earnings from major U.S. banks and key economic data, leading to clear selling pressure on tech stocks. However, AI developments continued: Meta (META‑US) rose 3.38% after launching its latest AI model Muse Wonder; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) announced its third‑generation self‑developed AI chip Maia 300, planning to deploy over one million units next year, showing big tech’s ongoing AI infrastructure investment; meanwhile, Micron (MU‑US) fell 3.88% as the market assessed competitive pressure from China’s ChangXin Memory.

Back to Taiwan, the weighted index was pressured at the open by weak U.S. tech stocks and news of Apple cutting orders. It plunged more than 1,200 points intraday, clearly shaking market sentiment. As the decline narrowed, it closed down 960.65 points at 48,341.31 with a turnover of 1,125.007 billion, leaving a lower‑shadow of 274.95 points, indicating buying support at lower levels. The monthly‑line support near the index is worth watching. Taiwan’s year‑to‑date gains remain relatively strong. Short‑term, international downside news and profit‑taking pressure cause a sizable correction, which is not surprising. From another angle, moderate consolidation helps chip accumulation. Those who wanted to buy earlier now face profit‑taking sell pressure, creating high‑volume activity. A gradual rise after a sharp fall is a bullish correction. Moreover, TSMC’s September revenue grew 54.6% YoY, breaking the NT$500 billion mark for two consecutive months, demonstrating AI demand and advanced‑process momentum. If the upcoming earnings briefing releases good news on Q4 operations, advanced‑process demand, and capex, the market could see a rebound.

The Taiwan market may dip first then rise. This week’s focus is dense, including TSMC’s earnings briefing (2330‑TW), U.S. September CPI, PPI and retail sales data. In addition, major banks such as Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), Citigroup (C‑US) and JPMorgan (JPM‑US) will release Q3 earnings, and ASML’s (ASML‑US) results and outlook are also worth watching. These data will move market expectations on inflation and interest‑rate trends.

Among heavyweight stocks, TSMC (2330‑TW) fell 1.97% to NT$2,490. Its earnings briefing is imminent, with the market focusing on revenue outlook, capex and the 2027 price‑increase strategy. Foreign investors are generally optimistic about AI computing, 3‑nm and 2‑nm demand, expecting full‑year revenue growth to be revised upward, and some even see stronger revenue next year. Capex is projected to stay high for several years, reflecting advanced‑process expansion and long‑term AI demand. Advanced‑process pricing may rise 5‑10%, boosting profits. Several foreign institutions have raised their target prices, showing confidence in TSMC’s long‑term competitiveness. The upcoming briefing will be a key market barometer.

Foxconn (2317‑TW) fell 1.84% to NT$240. At the 2026 OCP Global Summit, Foxconn showcased NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin NVL72 platform and a next‑generation AI rack solution, covering high‑speed interconnect, power supply and liquid‑cooling. Its subsidiary Hon Hai Precision (Hongbai Technology) provides NVIDIA platform support, while Foxconn Precision focuses on data‑center high‑speed transmission and cooling. Foxconn also partners with Intel (INTC‑US) to push Xeon‑based rack‑level AI solutions. As AI compute density and rack power consumption rise, Foxconn’s integration from key components to full‑rack systems positions it to capture data‑center construction opportunities, fueling long‑term growth.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) fell 2.16% to NT$4,525. September revenue was NT$55.4 billion, down 13.7% month‑over‑month, but Q3 revenue reached NT$168.1 billion, up 10.4% QoQ and 18.3% YoY, beating expectations and the upper end of forecasts, driven by flagship‑phone chip shipments and strong AI networking demand. Looking ahead to Q4, with ASIC business shipments starting, revenue and profit are expected to climb further. If TPU shipments double in 2027, MediaTek anticipates a larger share of supply, raising ASIC revenue proportion. With dual engines of mobile chips and AI computing, MediaTek’s long‑term growth momentum is promising.

paras: 一、盤勢結構：高檔放量重挫，短線賣壓加劇

台股今日呈現「開低震盪拉回」格局，盤中一度下跌1,235點、下探48,066點，終場下跌960點，收在48,341點，成交值放大至約1兆1,311億元。
指數跌破10日線，但仍守在月線之上，顯示短線多方動能受到壓抑，市場進入高檔籌碼重新整理階段，後續須觀察月線能否提供有效支撐。
國際油價攀升、通膨疑慮升溫、利率上行壓力，以及AI投資報酬與獲利變現疑慮，成為市場主要利空；加上高檔獲利了結與融資賣壓同步釋放，導致盤面震盪加劇。
籌碼方面，外資賣超1,653億元、自營商賣超569億元，投信則買超238億元。法人動向明顯分歧，短線應留意外資賣壓是否延續，以及市場成交量能否逐步收斂。


二、基本面分析：AI成長趨勢仍是多頭核心支柱

儘管短線面臨國際利率與估值修正壓力，但AI晶片新品放量、雲端服務業者持續擴大資本支出，以及先進製程與封裝需求成長，仍是支撐台股企業獲利的重要動能。
展望第四季，輝達Vera Rubin平台相關供應鏈、AI伺服器、先進封裝及高速傳輸等領域，可望受惠新平台導入與規格升級；蘋果新機出貨、歐美年末消費旺季，也有助部分電子供應鏈營收成長。
除電子產業外，金融股可留意利率環境對利差與獲利的影響；重電產業受惠海外電力建設需求，航運業則須觀察地緣政治與運價變化，塑化業則應同步評估原油成本與產品報價，掌握不同產業的輪動機會。
中長期而言，AI需求正由晶片延伸至資料中心、電力、散熱及高速互連，產業成長範圍擴大，有助支撐台股基本面。不過，企業資本支出能否轉化為實際營收與獲利，仍是後續評價能否維持的關鍵。


三、產業焦點：掌握AI基礎建設與規格升級商機

晶圓代工、先進製程與封裝設備： AI晶片持續追求高效能、低功耗，先進製程與CoWoS先進封裝需求仍值得關注。台積電(2330-TW)近期營運展望與法說內容，將是觀察AI需求能否持續轉化為實際營收的重要指標。
ASIC、高速傳輸與PCB材料： Google TPU、AWS Trainium及其他CSP自研晶片發展，有利IC設計服務、PCB、CCL、高階玻纖布及ABF載板需求。野村投信亦看好滑軌、散熱與CCL等供應鏈，但個別公司仍須檢視訂單、產能與毛利率變化。
散熱、電源與光通訊： AI伺服器功耗提高，帶動液冷、水冷板、電源管理與高速光連接需求，應優先關注具有量產實績、客戶認證及技術門檻的企業。
金融與傳產輪動： 金融股、重電、航運及塑化可作為分散布局方向，但須分別評估利率、海外訂單、地緣政治、運價及原料成本，避免僅憑題材追價。


四、技術面與籌碼：先觀察止跌訊號，不急著猜底

指數失守10日線且成交量放大，代表短線修正壓力升高；月線能否守穩、季線是否持續上揚，將是判斷中期多頭架構的重要依據。
外資單日大幅賣超，且新台幣走貶，顯示資金面仍有壓力。國際市場近期亦出現AI晶片股回檔，反映投資人開始更重視資本支出的獲利回收與投資報酬。
操作上應觀察下跌量能是否收斂、外資賣壓是否減輕，以及指數能否重新站回短期均線；若月線失守且反彈無量，應提高風險控管，不宜預設指數必然快速重返5萬點。


五、操作策略：選股不選市，分批布局優於追高

核心布局： 優先挑選訂單能見度高、獲利可持續成長、財務體質穩健的AI龍頭與關鍵零組件廠，譬如CPO概念股股大立光(3008-TW)、玉晶光(3406-TW)、中揚光(6668-TW)、冠西電(2466-TW)、網安其陽(3564-TW)、被動天二科(6834-TW)、LED雷笛克(5230-TW)、機構件閎暉(3311-TW)…等，其個股表現則是相當地亮眼。
進場原則： 等待股價回測支撐、賣壓減輕，再採分批布局；對高估值、短線急漲及獲利尚未兌現的個股，應保留安全邊際，譬如MCU應廣(6716-TW)、設備大量(3167-TW)、蔚華科(3055-TW)、PA全新(2455-TW)、光通訊聯亞(3081-TW)、上詮(3363-TW)、矽晶圓環球晶(6488-TW)、台勝科(3532-TW)、鋼鐵大甲(2221-TW)、彰源(2030-TW)、強新(5013-TW)…等，今日持續應聲下殺跌停，仍應速速避開之為宜。
風險管理： 避免融資追價，設定個股停損與持股比重，並持續追蹤美債殖利率、油價、匯率、法人籌碼及企業財報。


整體結論： 台股中長期仍有AI產業成長支撐，但短線已由單純追逐題材，轉向檢驗獲利與評價的階段。第四季可持續看好具實質訂單與獲利成長的優質企業，但應以基本面、技術面及風險控管並重，耐心等待合理買點，而非預設指數必然上漲。

The Taiwan market today displayed a "low‑open, choppy pull‑back" pattern, dropping as much as 1,235 points during the session to a low of 48,066 points, and closing down 960 points at 48,341 points with turnover swelling to about NT$1.1311 trillion. The next focus is whether the monthly line can provide solid support. Rising international oil prices, heightened inflation concerns, upward pressure on rates, and doubts about AI investment returns and profit realization are the main bearish factors; combined with profit‑taking at high levels and margin‑selling pressure, the market’s volatility intensified. In terms of capital flows, foreign investors sold NT$165.3 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$56.9 billion, while investment trusts bought NT$23.8 billion. Institutional actions are clearly divergent, and short‑term attention should be on whether foreign‑investor selling persists and whether trading volume gradually contracts.

3. Fundamental analysis: AI growth remains the core bullish pillar. Although short‑term pressures from international rates and valuation corrections exist, the rollout of new AI chips, continued cap‑ex by cloud service providers, and growth in advanced processes and packaging remain key drivers of Taiwanese corporate earnings. Looking into Q4, supply chains linked to Nvidia’s Vera Rubin platform, AI servers, advanced packaging and high‑speed interconnects are expected to benefit from new platform adoption and spec upgrades; Apple’s new device shipments and the year‑end consumer boom in Europe and the U.S. will also support parts of the electronics supply chain. Beyond electronics, financial stocks merit attention for rate‑environment impacts on spreads and profits; heavy‑industry gains from overseas power‑plant projects; shipping should be watched for geopolitical and freight‑rate shifts; plastics need to assess crude‑oil costs versus product pricing to capture sector‑rotation opportunities. In the medium‑to‑long term, AI demand is expanding from chips to data centers, power, cooling and high‑speed interconnects, broadening industry growth and underpinning Taiwan’s fundamentals. The index breaking below the 10‑day line with expanding volume signals heightened short‑term correction pressure; the stability of the monthly line and whether the quarterly line stays upward will be key to judging the medium‑term bullish structure. items.title: 力麗集團旗下天意能創整合四大戰隊 切入水資源、綠電與AI環工
items.title_en: Lih Li Group's Tianyi Energy Creation Forms Four Integrated Teams to Tackle Water Resources, Green Power and AI Environmental Engineering
paras: 力麗(1444-TW)集團旗下天意能創(4530-TW)定位為綠色基礎設施整合商，整合山林旭、環鼎國際、日向電能與同集團合作夥伴鴻傑工程為四大戰隊，以水資源、綠電與AI環工打造高科技廠與城市基建的綠色轉型大腦，公司指出，天意能創參展獲選 2026 台灣國際水週 AquaImpact 永續水標誌。
天意能創總經理李靜綺指出，AI 算力蓬勃發展帶動產業對水電資源效率的需求提升，天意能創將水與能源轉化為長期優質的營運資產，從源頭診斷到末端 AI 代操作一次打通，協助企業透過單一窗口提升營運韌性，讓每一滴水、每一度電，都發揮最大效益。

因應全球永續轉型浪潮與環保法規升級，企業面臨的廢水與能源問題往往同時涵蓋水質、設備選型、機電控制、工程施工及能耗管理，單一設備廠商無法解決整體問題。天意能創指出，公司承接力麗集團累積經驗，將水處理、再生水、再生能源與後端維運納入同一張藍圖，提供完整的一站式服務，消弭傳統多方對接的工程溝通成本。面對既有廠房設備老化與法規升級需求，天意能創能透過廠區健檢與前瞻設備布局，協助企業按預算與預期效益排出改善優先順序，讓投資精準落在有效環節並持續追蹤營運效益。
天意能創整合四個專業團隊，形成從研究、設計到維運的完整服務鏈。在創能綠電方面，日向電能提供太陽能結合儲能的光儲合一系統，協助企業自發自用、削峰填谷並具備停電備援。在精準設計方面，山林旭科技主導工程建置，導入BIM 3D精準建模，大幅降低管線衝突及有效落實設計，且擁有8件水回收相關專利，於設計階段即選用高效率鼓風機與變頻泵浦提升能效，並即時監控水質調整加藥。

天意能創指出，公司在核心淨水方面，環鼎國際擁有 25 年水處理經驗，代理關鍵核心技術之設備，日本三菱 MBR膜與瑞典 Nordic Water 盤式過濾器，並發展自主 ECO 系列技術、持有台灣發明與新型專利，設有自有實驗室並與大學建教合作，堅持先研究再規劃流程，專攻高難度水質處理，降低選錯設備風險。在AI智慧維運方面，天意能創與同屬力麗集團的合作夥伴鴻傑工程，建置 AI 雲端戰情室，依智慧儀表即時水質動態精準調控曝氣，最佳化水廠用電與營運效率。

天意能創並指出，公司團隊成員深耕水處理、水再生工程，山林旭積極參與國家級科學園區污水處理廠之建設，涵蓋竹科寶山二期擴建與中科二林園區等污水處理廠工程，累積多項實績。環鼎除了提供高雄楠梓污水處理廠處理量每日6萬噸盤式過濾系統，也參與高雄楠梓再生水廠興建，產水規模為每日7萬噸，包含MBR、MBBR、SUF等關鍵設備及系統設計，山林旭落實工程建置，完成可靠的工程交付。在 MBR 系統上，環鼎代理的三菱MBR膜在各科學園區污水處理廠應用廣泛。
依統計科學園區污水處理廠採用MBR系統處理的總水量合計約為每日25.9萬噸，其中17.9萬噸即採用三菱膜系統，占比約為70%。由團隊累積工程與操作維護的自主技術，已將臺灣經驗帶回日本，進行雙向技術交流與後續合作規劃。在AI智慧維運方面攜手合作夥伴鴻傑工程，建置 AI 雲端戰情室，將即時水質動態精準進行曝氣，水量等系統調配分析建議，提供水廠用電與營運效率最適化調整。
在水資源回收、節能與能源回收方面，天意能創已有具體成果：林口電廠 Eco-RO 水回收率逾 60%，臺中福田水資中心盤式過濾系統日處理量達10.5萬噸，台糖東海豐園區相較傳統豬舍節水約 80% 至 83% 且年減碳2000公噸。在廢水能源回收上，酒廠與合纖廠導入 Eco-ECSB 高效率顆粒污泥厭氧技術，其中合纖廠曝氣能耗減少 85%，並回收沼氣作為熱能與電力。
paras_en: Lih Li (1444-TW) Group’s subsidiary Tianyi Energy Creation (4530-TW) positions itself as a green infrastructure integrator, bringing together Shanlinxu, Huanding International, Nichiha Power and fellow group partner Hongjie Engineering as four major teams. By leveraging water resources, green power and AI‑enabled environmental engineering, it builds the “brain” for high‑tech factories and city infrastructure green transformation. The company notes that Tianyi Energy Creation was selected for the 2026 Taiwan International Water Week AquaImpact Sustainable Water Mark.

General Manager Li Jing‑qi explained that the rapid growth of AI computing is driving higher demand for water‑electricity efficiency across industries. Tianyi Energy Creation converts water and energy into long‑term high‑quality operating assets, linking source‑side diagnostics to end‑point AI‑driven operations in a single workflow. This helps enterprises boost operational resilience through a one‑stop portal, ensuring every drop of water and every kilowatt‑hour delivers maximum benefit.

In response to the global sustainability transition and tightening environmental regulations, companies face wastewater and energy challenges that span water quality, equipment selection, electromechanical control, construction and energy‑use management—issues a single equipment vendor cannot solve. Tianyi Energy Creation says it leverages Lih Li Group’s accumulated experience to integrate water treatment, reclaimed water, renewable energy and downstream O&M into one blueprint, offering a complete one‑stop service that eliminates the communication costs of traditional multi‑vendor projects. Confronting aging plant equipment and regulatory upgrades, the firm can conduct plant health checks and forward‑looking equipment planning to help firms prioritize improvements within budget and expected ROI, directing investment to the most effective points and continuously tracking operational benefits.

Tianyi Energy Creation unites four professional teams to create a full service chain from research and design to operation and maintenance. For green power generation, Nichiha Power supplies a solar‑plus‑storage “photovoltaic‑storage‑in‑one” system that enables self‑consumption, peak shaving, load shifting and backup during outages. In precision design, Shanlinxu Technology leads engineering construction, employing BIM 3D modeling to dramatically reduce pipe conflicts and ensure design fidelity. It holds eight water‑recycling‑related patents and selects high‑efficiency blowers and variable‑frequency pumps during the design phase to boost energy efficiency, while providing real‑time water‑quality monitoring and dosing control.

Tianyi Energy Creation notes that in core water‑purification, Huanding International brings 25 years of water‑treatment expertise, representing key technologies such as Japan’s Mitsubishi MBR membranes and Sweden’s Nordic Water disc filters. It has also developed its own ECO series, holds Taiwanese invention and utility patents, operates an in‑house laboratory and collaborates with universities, adhering to a research‑first approach for high‑difficulty water‑quality treatment and reducing the risk of selecting wrong equipment. For AI‑driven O&M, Tianyi Energy Creation partners with fellow Lih Li Group member Hongjie Engineering to build an AI cloud “war‑room,” using smart meters to dynamically and precisely control aeration based on real‑time water‑quality data, optimizing plant electricity use and operational efficiency.

The company’s team members have deep experience in water treatment and water‑recycling projects. Shanlinxu actively participates in national science‑park wastewater‑treatment plant construction, including the Phase‑2 expansion of Zhuke Baoshan and the Zhongke Erlin park, accumulating numerous achievements. Huanding supplies a 60,000‑ton‑per‑day disc‑filter system for Kaohsiung Nanzhi wastewater‑treatment plant and also contributes to the Kaohsiung Nanzhi reclaimed‑water plant producing 70,000 tons per day, featuring MBR, MBBR, SUF and other key equipment and system designs. Shanlinxu executes the engineering build, delivering reliable project hand‑over. Huanding’s Mitsubishi MBR membranes are widely used in science‑park wastewater plants.

Statistics show that science‑park wastewater plants using MBR systems treat about 259,000 tons of water daily, of which 179,000 tons (≈70 %) employ Mitsubishi membranes. The team’s accumulated engineering and maintenance expertise has been transferred back to Japan, enabling two‑way technology exchange and future collaboration planning. In AI‑enabled O&M, together with Hongjie Engineering, they have established an AI cloud war‑room that performs real‑time, precise aeration based on water‑quality dynamics and provides system‑level water‑flow and equipment allocation recommendations to optimize plant electricity consumption and operational efficiency.

In water‑resource recovery, energy saving and energy‑recovery, Tianyi Energy Creation already reports concrete results: at Linkou Power Plant the Eco‑RO system achieves over 60 % water‑recovery; Taichung Futian Water Resource Center’s disc‑filter system handles 105,000 tons per day; Taiwan Sugar’s Donghai Feng Park reduces water use by about 80‑83 % compared with conventional pig farms and cuts carbon emissions by 2,000 tons annually. For wastewater‑to‑energy, a distillery and a fiber‑manufacturing plant have adopted Eco‑ECSB high‑efficiency granular sludge anaerobic technology, with the fiber plant’s aeration energy dropping 85 % and biogas being recovered for heat and power.

items.title: 和椿Q3營收寫歷年單季新高 半導體、AI伺服器拉貨動能強勁
items.title_en: He Chun Reports Record Q3 Revenue, Driven by Strong Semiconductor and AI Server Demand
paras: AI與機器人自動化解決廠和椿(6215-TW)今(2026)年第3季合併營收達11.13億元、年增57.93%，改寫歷年單季新高，主要受惠於半導體、高階 AI 伺服器、電子製造等產業客戶對自動化設備與次系統(Subsystem)拉貨動能延續，和椿今年營收逐季走高，累計前3季合併營收 27.88億元，年增 55.39%。
和椿9月單月營收3.28億元，年增28.87%、月減19.59%，月減主因為部分自動化設備與次系統訂單，配合客戶現場建置時程及驗收規畫調整而遞延出貨，屬自動化設備產業常見的短期出貨節奏變化，並不影響整體訂單規模，遞延訂單將陸續於後續季度完成交貨與認列營收，整體出貨動能無虞。

近年全球機器人產業熱度升溫，從工業到自主移動機器人(AMR)紛紛加速落地，市場焦點已逐漸從「機器人本體」轉向「AI 控制與系統整合」，和椿指出，「機器人如果只有強大的機體與關節，充其量只是空有身體，真正的關鍵在於軟體控制、AI 視覺辨識以及感測決策系統，也就是機器人的大腦，隨著 AI 技術逐步進入實體應用，終端客戶不再滿足於採購單一品牌的機械手臂或移動載具，而是需要能配合複雜製程、彈性調度且高精度的「客製化AI智慧機器人整合解決方案」，讓軟硬體高度協同運作。
和椿近年來已成功轉型為高附加價值的「AI 智慧機器人整合解決方案商」，代理精密零組件起步，累積自研控制模組與自動化設備的研發製造實力，長期深耕半導體、電子製造等高科技產業，熟悉客戶的製程與現場作業條件。延伸至機器人領域後，更能從客戶的場域痛點出發，讓機器人與自動化設備在現場高效落地，協助半導體、AI伺服器、電子製造及物流等各產業客戶大幅降低導入自動化的門檻。
和椿近年來已成功轉型為高附加價值的「AI 智慧機器人整合解決方案商」，代理精密零組件起步，逐步累積自研控制模組與自動化設備的研發製造實力，長期深耕半導體、電子製造等高科技產業，熟悉客戶的製程與現場作業條件，讓機器人與自動化設備在現場高效落地，協助半導體、AI伺服器、電子製造及物流等各產業客戶大幅降低導入自動化的門檻。
展望未來，和椿將持續鎖定「半導體高階次系統」與「AI智慧機器人」兩大成長引擎，在第一曲線的自動化設備與次系統上深化技術護城河，更在第二曲線積極布局跨系統、多型態機器人的「無人工廠」與垂直場景落地方案，全力推升公司整體營運長期良好的成長動能。
paras_en: AI and robotics automation solutions provider He Chun (6215-TW) posted combined Q3 2026 revenue of NT$1.113 billion, up 57.93% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑quarter record. The surge was fueled by continued demand from semiconductor, high‑end AI server and electronics manufacturing customers for automation equipment and subsystems. He Chun’s revenue has risen each quarter this year, reaching NT$2.788 billion for the first three quarters, a 55.39% annual increase.

In September, He Chun recorded NT$328 million in revenue, up 28.87% year‑over‑year but down 19.59% month‑over‑month. The monthly decline reflects the postponement of some automation equipment and subsystem orders to align with customers’ on‑site installation schedules and acceptance plans – a typical short‑term fluctuation in the automation industry that does not affect the overall order volume. Deferred orders will be delivered and recognized as revenue in subsequent quarters, so overall shipment momentum remains intact.

The global robotics industry has heated up in recent years, with both industrial robots and autonomous mobile robots (AMR) accelerating deployment. Market focus is shifting from the robot hardware itself to AI control and system integration. He Chun notes that a robot with only a strong chassis and joints is merely a body; the real key lies in software control, AI visual recognition, and sensor‑based decision‑making – essentially the robot’s brain. As AI technologies move into physical applications, end‑users no longer settle for a single‑brand robotic arm or mobile platform; they demand customized AI‑smart robot integration solutions that can handle complex processes, flexible scheduling, and high precision, enabling tight hardware‑software synergy.

In recent years He Chun has successfully transformed into a high‑value‑added “AI smart robot integration solutions” provider. Starting with the distribution of precision components, the company has built in‑house capabilities in control modules and automation equipment R&D and manufacturing, deeply serving high‑tech sectors such as semiconductors and electronics manufacturing and gaining intimate knowledge of customers’ processes and on‑site conditions. Expanding into robotics, He Chun now addresses customers’ pain points by deploying robots and automation equipment efficiently on the shop floor, helping semiconductor, AI server, electronics manufacturing and logistics customers dramatically lower the barriers to automation adoption.

He Chun has evolved into a high‑value‑added “AI smart robot integration solutions” vendor, beginning with precision component distribution and gradually accumulating self‑developed control modules and automation equipment manufacturing expertise. By long‑term engagement with semiconductor and electronics manufacturing industries, it understands customers’ processes and on‑site operational requirements, enabling robots and automation gear to be deployed efficiently on the floor and assisting clients in sectors such as semiconductors, AI servers, electronics manufacturing and logistics to significantly reduce automation entry hurdles.

Looking ahead, He Chun will continue to focus on two growth engines – advanced semiconductor subsystems and AI‑smart robots. It will deepen its technological moat on the first‑line automation equipment and subsystems while actively developing cross‑system, multi‑type robot “lights‑out factory” and vertical‑scenario solutions on the second line, driving sustained long‑term growth for the company.

items.title: 大魯閣在日本開匹克球俱樂部 明年起逐步發展連鎖經營
items.title_en: Taroko to Open Pickleball Club in Japan, Plans Chain Expansion Starting Next Year
paras: 大魯閣(1432-TW)今(13)日宣布，除了在日本開出棒壘球打擊場，預計12月下旬將在日本開「大魯閣匹克球俱樂部」，並與日本匹克球聯盟合作，明年起逐步發展成連鎖經營。
大魯閣瞄準匹克球市場，與JR東日本集團旗下「JR東日本都市開發株式會社」戰略合作，以運動休閒項目為主題、並活化鐵路沿線空間，預計12月下旬在千葉縣JR下總中山站附近，開首家大魯閣匹克球俱樂部(TAROKO Pickleball Club)。
大魯閣說明，匹克球俱樂部是利用鐵路高架橋下空間打造的全天候匹克球場，初期設置2面球場，預計明年起陸續擴充。
大魯閣近年積極拓展海外版圖，在美國已開5家據點，包括德州Katy、San Antonio，以及亞利桑那州Mesa、Chandler、Gilbert，透過大型室內運動娛樂中心與既有戶外場館改造，持續驗證不同店型的營運模式。
大魯閣在日本的首二座棒壘球打擊場也在近期開出，分別為千葉、宇都宮雙店，隨著美國5店、日本2店陸續加入營運，海外布局第一階段目標達陣。
展望下一階段，大魯閣表示，以「輕資產拓點、多元運動娛樂、棒球科技應用」為發展方向，持續深化在美國和日本市場的經營，拚做出源自台灣、走向國際的棒球運動娛樂品牌。
paras_en: Taroko (1432-TW) announced today, October 13, that in addition to opening a baseball‑softball batting cage in Japan, it plans to launch a "Taroko Pickleball Club" in late December and, in partnership with the Japan Pickleball League, will gradually develop a chain operation starting next year.

Targeting the growing pickleball market, Taroko is forming a strategic partnership with JR East’s subsidiary JR East Urban Development Co., focusing on sports‑leisure projects that revitalize spaces along railway lines. The first Taroko Pickleball Club (TAROKO Pickleball Club) is slated to open near JR Nakayama Station in Chiba Prefecture in late December.
Taroko explained that the pickleball club will be an all‑weather facility built under a railway viaduct, initially featuring two courts, with plans to expand further beginning next year.

In recent years Taroko has been actively expanding overseas. In the United States it already operates five locations—in Katy, Texas; San Antonio, Texas; and Mesa, Chandler and Gilbert in Arizona—using large indoor sports‑entertainment centers and converting existing outdoor venues, continuously testing different store formats.

Taroko’s first two baseball‑softball batting cages in Japan have also opened recently, located in Chiba and Utsunomiya. With the five U.S. sites and the two Japanese sites now operating, the first phase of its overseas rollout has been achieved.

Looking ahead to the next phase, Taroko says it will pursue a "light‑asset, multi‑sport entertainment, baseball‑technology" development strategy, deepening its presence in the U.S. and Japanese markets to build a baseball‑sports entertainment brand that originates in Taiwan and goes global.

items.title: 大魯閣插旗日本關東開出二大據點 將發展日本連鎖版圖
items.title_en: DaLuGe Flags Japan's Kanto Region with Two Major Sites, Aiming to Build a Japanese Chain Network
paras: 大魯閣實業(1432-TW)今(13)日宣布，海外市場布局創新里程碑，成功插旗日本，首波二家店開在關東地區，千葉店和宇都宮店將於10月10日正式開幕，並將作為未來加速在日本拓點的營運模組。
大魯閣表示，在日本的二大新據點是透過收購既有棒壘球打擊場來改造升級，以較低的資本投入及較短的籌備時間進入日本市場，並導入台灣成熟的運動娛樂經營模式及棒球科技。
大魯閣看好日本擁有深厚的棒球文化和廣大的棒球人口，打擊場具有穩定的市場基礎，但現有場館多以傳統投球機及單一打擊服務為主，部分場館面臨服務單一及營運模式缺乏創新等挑戰。
反觀台式打擊場結合多元球速與科技互動，並增加飛鏢機、娃娃機等遊戲娛樂及親子休閒服務，可讓棒球打擊從單純的練習活動，延伸為適合家庭、朋友及年輕族群參與的運動娛樂體驗。
大魯閣樂觀看日本既有打擊場的轉型商機，後續仍將尋找合適場館，透過收購、設備升級和營運內容優化，以較低資本支出加速拓點，逐步建立可複製的日本營運模式。
除了傳統打擊娛樂，大魯閣也將日本據點作為棒球運動科技的實際應用場域，第一階段導入美國HitTrax打擊系統，透過即時數據分析與互動競賽功能，提升打擊體驗與訓練效率，後續更規劃導入台灣自主研發的AI棒球打擊教練，提供個人化打擊分析與訓練建議。
paras_en: DaLuGe Industrial (1432-TW) announced today (the 13th) that it has reached a new milestone in its overseas market expansion by successfully planting its flag in Japan. The first two stores, located in the Kanto region, are the Chiba store and the Utsunomiya store, which will officially open on October 10 and will serve as the operational model for accelerating further expansion in Japan.

DaLuGe explained that the two new sites in Japan were created by acquiring existing baseball/softball batting facilities and upgrading them, allowing market entry with lower capital investment and a shorter preparation period. The company will introduce Taiwan’s mature sports‑entertainment management model and baseball technology into these venues.

DaLuGe is optimistic about Japan’s deep baseball culture and large baseball‑playing population, noting that batting facilities have a stable market base. However, many existing venues rely on traditional pitching machines and offer only single‑service batting, facing challenges such as limited service offerings and a lack of innovative operating models.

In contrast, Taiwanese‑style batting centers combine varied pitch speeds with interactive technology and add games such as darts and claw machines, as well as family‑friendly leisure services. This transforms baseball batting from a purely practice activity into a sports‑entertainment experience suitable for families, friends and younger audiences.

DaLuGe is positive about the transformation opportunities for existing Japanese batting facilities. It will continue to seek suitable venues and, through acquisitions, equipment upgrades and content optimization, accelerate expansion with relatively low capital outlay, gradually establishing a replicable operating model in Japan.

Beyond traditional batting entertainment, DaLuGe will use its Japanese sites as real‑world applications for baseball technology. In the first phase it will install the U.S. HitTrax batting system, leveraging real‑time data analysis and interactive competition features to enhance the batting experience and training efficiency. Future plans include introducing Taiwan‑developed AI baseball batting coaches to provide personalized analysis and training recommendations.

items.title: 多頭滿四年藏隱憂！標普500逾八成個股從高點跌逾10% 專家揭：全靠少數科技巨頭苦撐
items.title_en: Bull Market Lasts Four Years but Hidden Risks Loom! Over 80% of S&P 500 Stocks Down More Than 10% From Peaks, Experts Say: Only a Few Tech Giants Are Holding It Up
paras: 根據市場分析機構Kobeissi Letter最新分析，目前標普500指數約84%的成分股，股價較各自歷史高點至少下跌10%，顯示若沒有一些大型股的亮眼漲勢支撐，標普500指數的表現恐怕將相當難看，也難以持續徘徊在歷史高點附近。
Yahoo Finance報導，目前標普500指數的11個類股中，房地產類股回檔最嚴重，97%的成分股較歷史高點下跌至少10%，符合技術面「修正」的定義。次差為原物料類股，占96%，接著為公用事業類股，占94%，以及非必需消費品類股，占92%。
這些產業的疲弱，可能反映市場對企業獲利的疑慮，尤其是房市與零售業等易受高利率影響的產業。
相較之下，能源類股表現相對抗跌，僅62%的成分股較歷史高點下跌逾10%，接著是醫療保健類股，占70%，科技類股則占72%。
如果把門檻改成從高點回跌至少20%，也就是華爾街傳統上所稱的「熊市」，標普500指數有59%的成分股已符合這個標準。跌幅超過30%占了41%，跌了超過50%的另有17%。
Kobeissi Letter策略師說：「少數幾檔股票正支撐著整個股市。」
儘管標普500指數表面之下的跌勢持續擴大，市場仍完成一項重要里程碑。根據Truist共同投資長Keith Lerner提供的數據，投資人目前正處於1950年代以來的第11次多頭市場。
這波多頭行情在周二(10月12日)滿四年，成為歷來第七次持續至少完整四年的多頭市場。標普500指數周二幾乎收在平盤，小跌4.30點或不到0.1%，收在7807.24點。
若與1950年代以來的歷次多頭市場相比，本輪行情累計上漲119%，漲幅大致位於中間水準，遠低於2009年至2020年多頭市場的401%，也不及1987年至2000年多頭市場的582%。
Lerner統計期間內，多頭市場的平均漲幅為184%。而過去10次多頭市場中，有六次持續時間超過四年。
paras_en: According to the latest analysis from market‑research firm Kobeissi Letter, about 84% of the S&P 500’s constituents are trading at least 10% below their respective historical highs, indicating that without the strong gains of a handful of large‑cap stocks, the index’s performance could look bleak and it will struggle to stay near its record levels.

Yahoo Finance reports that among the S&P 500’s 11 sectors, real‑estate stocks have the steepest pull‑back, with 97% of the sector’s components down at least 10% from their peaks, meeting the technical definition of a correction. The next worst sector is materials at 96%, followed by utilities at 94% and consumer discretionary at 92%.
The weakness in these industries may reflect market doubts about corporate earnings, especially in sectors such as housing and retail that are highly sensitive to higher interest rates.
By contrast, energy stocks have been relatively resilient, with only 62% of the sector’s constituents down more than 10% from their highs, followed by health‑care at 70% and technology at 72%.

If the threshold is widened to a drop of at least 20% from peak – the level traditionally called a “bear market” on Wall Street – 59% of S&P 500 components meet that criterion. Stocks down over 30% account for 41%, and those down more than 50% make up another 17%.
A Kobeissi Letter strategist said, “A handful of stocks are propping up the entire market.”

Even though the underlying decline beneath the S&P 500’s surface is widening, the market has still achieved a key milestone. Data from Truist co‑CIO Keith Lerner shows investors are currently in the 11th bull market since the 1950s.

The current bull run hit the four‑year mark on Tuesday, October 12, becoming the seventh instance in history of a bull market lasting at least a full four years. The S&P 500 closed Tuesday almost flat, down 4.30 points or less than 0.1% at 7,807.24.

Compared with every bull market since the 1950s, this rally has risen a cumulative 119%, a mid‑range gain that is far below the 401% rise in the 2009‑2020 bull market and the 582% gain in the 1987‑2000 bull market.
Lerner notes that the average gain across bull markets in the sample period is 184%, and that six of the past ten bull markets have lasted more than four years.

items.title: 博通執行長：許多AI投資人就像賭徒　根本不知道自己在投資什麼
items.title_en: Broadcom CEO: Many AI Investors Are Like Gamblers Who Don’t Even Know What They’re Investing In
paras: 博通執行長陳福陽最新示警，部分押注AI與晶片的資金像賭場賭徒，「很多投資人根本不知道自己在投什麼」，對回報抱過高預期，卻忽略模型訓練、資料中心與融資成本。他還認為，AI下一步瓶頸未必是晶片、記憶體或電力，而是資本，隨著利率與債務成本上升，資金可得性恐壓過硬體供給。
陳福陽在新加坡星展亞洲未來前瞻大會上以OpenAI為例指出，9月年化營收約500億美元，證明生成式AI有收入潛力，但因巨額訓練與基建支出仍虧損，「只能說商業潛力大，不代表長期獲利已驗證」。
他並批評企業只用token做試驗、難以轉化收益，像是如電玩店投10美元幣十分鐘輸光，大模型開發商應鎖定能靠AI創收的客戶，而非燒錢試水。
目前，市場已呈現降溫訊號。輝達支持的澳洲資料中心業者Firmus Grid上周撤銷最高55億美元IPO，轉向私募，顯示公開市場對AI基礎建設估值趨謹慎。
分析師也指出，交易員正從「AI故事」轉向現金流、資本開支報酬率與融資成本，產業進入重新定價期。
paras_en: Broadcom CEO Hock Tan warned that some of the money betting on AI and chips is behaving like casino gamblers – “many investors have no idea what they’re actually investing in,” he said, holding overly high expectations for returns while overlooking the costs of model training, data centers and financing. He added that the next bottleneck for AI may not be chips, memory or power, but capital, as rising interest rates and debt costs could make funding scarcer than hardware supply.

Speaking at DBS Asia Future Forum in Singapore, Tan used OpenAI as an example, noting that its annualized revenue in September was about $50 billion, showing that generative AI has revenue potential. However, because of massive training and infrastructure expenses it is still loss‑making, and “you can only say the commercial potential is big, not that long‑term profitability has been proven.”

He also criticized companies that only experiment with tokens and struggle to turn them into revenue, likening it to a video‑game arcade where you spend $10 and lose it in ten minutes. He said large‑model developers should focus on customers who can actually generate revenue with AI, rather than burning cash to test the waters.

The market is already showing cooling signs. Firmus Grid, an Australian data‑center operator backed by Nvidia, withdrew its planned $5.5 billion IPO last week and is now seeking private funding, indicating that public markets are becoming more cautious in valuing AI infrastructure.
Analysts also note that traders are shifting focus from the “AI story” to cash flow, capital‑expenditure returns and financing costs, signaling that the industry is entering a re‑pricing phase.

items.title: 蘇納克：科技巨頭發債2027年將超越美國政府
items.title_en: Sunak: Tech Giants' Bond Issuance Will Surpass U.S. Government by 2027
paras: 前英國首相、現任 AI 開發商 Anthropic 高級顧問蘇納克(Rishi Sunak)周二(13日) 在紐德里舉行的彭博新經濟論壇上指出，隨著人工智慧(AI)投資需求爆發，，預計將在 2027 年超越美國政府，成為 10 年期以上長期債券的最大淨發行者。
他提到的科技巨頭，主要為雲端超大規模業者，包括Meta(META-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、Amazon(AMZN-US)、Microsoft (MSFT-US)及 Oracle (ORCL-US)等企業。
蘇納克強調，建置資料中心與 AI 基礎設施所需的資本極為龐大，此需求正與各國政府赤字膨脹疊加，對全球債務市場產生深刻變革。
在蘇納克提出此意見當下，AI 相關發債規模已大幅翻倍。其中，英國央行數據顯示，2026 年超大規模業者已佔英國英鎊企業債券總銷售額的 47%。
截至 2026 年 9 月初，全球與 AI 相關的債務發行量已達約 4,500 億美元，約為 2025 年總量的兩倍；預估 2027 年超大規模業者的債券發行量將介於 2,500 億至 4,000 億美元之間。
此前，摩根大通預測，2026 年至 2030 年間，由債務驅動的 AI 相關支出總額將高達 4.1 兆美元。
包括英國央行與IMF(國際貨幣基金)均提醒，科技巨頭發債熱潮與高槓桿融資，不僅與美國公債爭奪資金、推升借貸成本，若 AI 生產力回報不如預期，更可能對全球金融穩定帶來系統性風險。
paras_en: Former UK prime minister and current Anthropic senior adviser Rishi Sunak said on Tuesday (the 13th) at Bloomberg’s New Economy Forum in New Delhi that the explosion in demand for AI investment is expected to make tech giants the largest net issuers of 10‑year‑plus bonds by 2027, overtaking the U.S. government.
He referred to the cloud‑scale tech giants, including Meta (META-US), Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon (AMZN-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and Oracle (ORCL-US).

Sunak stressed that the capital required to build data centres and AI infrastructure is enormous, and this demand, combined with expanding government deficits worldwide, will bring a profound shift to the global debt market.

At the time Sunak made the comment, AI‑related bond issuance had already more than doubled. Bank of England data show that in 2026, ultra‑large tech firms accounted for 47% of total sterling corporate bond sales in the UK.

By early September 2026, global AI‑related debt issuance had reached roughly $450 billion, about twice the total in 2025, and the 2027 bond issuance by ultra‑large tech firms is projected to lie between $250 billion and $400 billion.
Previously, JPMorgan forecast that AI‑related spending driven by debt from 2026 to 2030 could total as much as $4.1 trillion.

Both the Bank of England and the IMF have warned that the tech‑giant bond‑raising frenzy and high‑leverage financing not only compete with U.S. Treasuries for funding and push up borrowing costs, but also, if AI productivity falls short of expectations, could pose systemic risks to global financial stability.

items.title: 開車免握方向盤、免盯路！通用拚2028年推新駕駛技術 凱迪拉克首搭
items.title_en: Drive without holding the steering wheel, without watching the road! GM pushes new driver technology for 2028, Cadillac first to adopt
paras: 通用汽車(GM-US) 執行長芭拉（Mary Barra）週一(12日)表示，該車廠仍朝向在 2028 年推出「手眼皆可離車」自動駕駛技術的目標邁進。
通用去年10月宣布，計畫於2028年率先在凱迪拉克（Cadillac）電動休旅車Escalade IQ搭載下一代駕駛輔助系統，之後再擴大至其他車款。
現有的Super Cruise系統雖允許駕駛放開方向盤，但仍要求持續留意路況；新技術則旨在讓駕駛於特定條件下，無須持續注視路面。
芭拉在CNBC節目《Mad Money》接受主持人克雷默（Jim Cramer）訪問時表示，她最近親自測試這項技術，相較於3月先前試乘時的表現，進步幅度令她印象深刻。
她說：「團隊朝著2028年左右實現視線與雙手都能放開的目標，取得了很大進展。我們將在個人用車自動駕駛領域占有有利地位。」
芭拉並補充：「當人們想開車時，可以自己開；隨著這項技術發展，不想開車時，就不必親自駕駛。」
通用在Cruise自駕計程車業務投入逾100億美元後，於2024年12月決定退出，隨後轉向發展個人用車自動駕駛技術。面對競爭日益激烈的無人駕駛叫車市場，通用選擇將資源轉向消費者自有車輛的自動駕駛系統。
芭拉表示：「我們不是做計程車生意，也不是做巴士生意。」
她坦承退出 Robotaxi 市場是一個艱難的決定，但她為此決策辯護，並強調通用汽車留下了 Cruise 的核心團隊轉而投入個人自駕技術的研發。她強調這雖然不易，但絕對是正確的決定。
此外，芭拉也駁斥了自駕車普及最終將降低個人車輛持有需求的觀點。
她回顧過往市場曾預測 Uber 和 Lyft 等叫車服務將導致汽車銷量銳減，但事實證明該預測並未實現，因為人們依然極為看重將車輛停在自家車道上的價值，那代表著隨時隨地自由出行的主導權。
paras_en: General Motors (GM-US) CEO Mary Barra said on Monday (the 12th) that the automaker is still moving toward its goal of launching a “hands‑free, eyes‑free” autonomous driving technology by 2028.
GM announced last October that it plans to debut the next‑generation driver assistance system on the Cadillac Escalade IQ electric SUV in 2028, then expand it to other models thereafter.

The current Super Cruise system allows drivers to take their hands off the wheel but still requires them to keep their eyes on the road; the new technology aims to let drivers look away under certain conditions.
Barra told CNBC’s “Mad Money” host Jim Cramer that she recently tested the technology herself and was impressed by how much it had improved since her ride in March.

She said, “The team has made great progress toward the goal of being able to look away and take both hands off the wheel around 2028. We will have a strong position in the personal‑vehicle autonomous driving space.”
Barra added, “When people want to drive, they can drive themselves; as this technology develops, they won’t have to drive when they don’t want to.”

After investing more than $10 billion in its Cruise autonomous‑taxi business, GM decided in December 2024 to exit that market and shift focus to personal‑vehicle autonomous driving technology, redirecting resources toward consumer‑owned cars as competition in the robo‑taxi space intensifies.
Barra said, “We’re not in the taxi business, and we’re not in the bus business.”

She admitted that exiting the robotaxi market was a tough decision but defended it, emphasizing that GM retained Cruise’s core team to work on personal‑driving technology, noting that while it’s challenging, it is unquestionably the right move.
Barra also rejected the view that widespread autonomous vehicles will ultimately reduce personal car ownership demand.

She recalled past forecasts that ride‑hailing services like Uber and Lyft would sharply cut car sales, but those predictions have not materialized because people still highly value having a vehicle parked in their own driveway, which represents the freedom to travel whenever they wish.

items.title: 中國AI晶片市占洗牌！輝達上半年出貨量年減44% 華為市占率逼近
items.title_en: China AI Chip Market Share Reshuffled! Nvidia's H1 Shipments Down 44% YoY, Huawei's Share Nears Parity
paras: 路透引述市調機構IDC一份報告指出，美國出口管制限制輝達(NVDA-US)產品供應，加上華為等中國本土業者持續搶市，讓輝達2026年上半年在中國資料中心AI晶片市場的市占率大幅下降至34%。
IDC數據顯示，輝達今年1月至6月在中國的AI加速器出貨量為67.8萬顆，較去年同期減少44%。IDC並未說明輝達34%的市占率涵蓋哪些產品，也未確認是否包括B200、B300等先進晶片。輝達未對報導置評。

華為市占率達28% 九家中國晶片業者出貨成長

至於華為，上半年出貨57.2萬顆AI加速器，高於去年同期的逾30萬顆，市占率達28%，與輝達的差距縮小。
其他中國晶片業者也持續擴大市率。阿里巴巴(09988-HK)旗下晶片設計部門平頭哥市占率為7%，寒武紀(688256-CN)為5%，百度(09888-HK)旗下昆侖芯為4%，海光信息(688041-CN)則為3%。
在IDC追蹤的11家中國晶片業者中，有九家上半年出貨量較去年同期增加。
由於美國限制中國取得輝達最先進的AI晶片，也限縮了輝達可在中國銷售的產品範圍。在此同時，北京積極推動國產替代品，並要求中國企業在進口符合出口規定的輝達晶片之前，須先取得批准。
輝達執行長黃仁勳多次批評美國出口管制政策，表示這項政策迫使美國企業把規模達500億美元的中國AI晶片市場，拱手讓給華為。

非GPU晶片出貨量超越GPU 國產替代持續擴大

IDC數據顯示，中國今年上半年AI加速器總出貨量達200.8萬顆。其中，最廣泛用於訓練AI模型的繪圖處理器(GPU)出貨量年減26%，降至99.1萬顆，反映符合規定且可在中國大陸銷售的GPU供應仍然有限。
其他類型的AI加速器出貨量則大增近80%至101.6萬顆，數量首度超越GPU。這類晶片包括專為特定AI工作設計的產品，例如執行已訓練完成的模型。
華為、平頭哥、昆侖芯與寒武紀合計占非GPU晶片市場的95%。IDC指出，這類晶片已被政府機構、網路公司及電信業者採用。
IDC表示，市場競爭焦點正從單顆晶片的效能，轉向整體系統能力，包括晶片在大型運算叢集中的協調運作表現。
IDC預估，中國今年AI加速器總出貨量將成長19%，儘管GPU出貨量預料下滑9%。
paras_en: Reuters, citing an IDC report, said U.S. export controls limiting Nvidia (NVDA-US) product supply and competition from Chinese firms such as Huawei have driven Nvidia's market share in China's data‑center AI chip market down sharply to 34% in the first half of 2026.

IDC data show Nvidia shipped 678,000 AI accelerators in China from January to June, a 44% drop from the same period last year. IDC did not specify which products are included in the 34% share, nor confirm whether advanced chips such as the B200 or B300 are counted. Nvidia did not comment on the report.
Huawei shipped 572,000 AI accelerators in the first half, up from just over 300,000 a year earlier, giving it a 28% market share and narrowing the gap with Nvidia.

Other Chinese chip makers are also expanding their shares: Alibaba’s (09988-HK) chip design unit Pingtouge holds 7%, Cambricon (688256-CN) 5%, Baidu’s (09888-HK) Kunlun Chip 4%, and Hai Guang Information (688041-CN) 3%.
Among the 11 Chinese chip firms tracked by IDC, nine saw higher shipments in the first half than in the same period last year.

U.S. restrictions on China’s access to Nvidia’s most advanced AI chips have narrowed the range of Nvidia products that can be sold in China. At the same time, Beijing is actively promoting domestic alternatives and requires Chinese firms to obtain approval before importing Nvidia chips that meet export rules.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has repeatedly criticized U.S. export controls, saying the policy forces American companies to hand over the roughly $50 billion Chinese AI‑chip market to Huawei.

IDC data show total AI‑accelerator shipments in China reached 2.008 million units in the first half of the year. GPU shipments, which are most widely used for training AI models, fell 26% year‑on‑year to 991,000 units, indicating that GPUs compliant with export rules and allowed for sale in mainland China remain limited.

Shipments of non‑GPU AI accelerators surged nearly 80% to 1.016 million units, overtaking GPUs for the first time. These chips are designed for specific AI workloads, such as running already‑trained models.
